# Navicat import fixtures

Synthetic test data for the Navicat import and the `.nb3` reader. Every file here was written by
hand (or generated by the test suite) to follow the file layout documented in
[`docs/navicat-storage.md`](../../../docs/navicat-storage.md), which was observed on files the
project's author created with their own Navicat installation. None of these files is copied
from a real installation, and none is part of Navicat or derived from its program files.

- `Common/conn.plist`, `Common/pref.plist`: fictitious connections on `127.0.0.1`, `localhost`
  and reserved documentation addresses (`203.0.113.10`, `lab.example.lan`), with no passwords.
- `Navicat for MySQL/Profiles/*.nbatmysql`, `schedule.plist`: fictitious batch jobs; the e-mail
  fields are empty.
- `backups/demo/*.nb3`: a small synthetic backup of a demo schema with made-up rows.

Never add real hosts, user names, passwords, e-mail addresses or data to this folder.
